primary_sources.title: Task 004 Extraction Integration - Apple 2024 10-K Chunks
primary_sources.synthesis: Extracted 129 text chunks (256,563 characters) from Apple Inc. 2024 10-K HTML filing. Includes ESG keywords (climate, environmental, emissions, risk) and section markers (Item 1A, Risk Factors). SHA256 hash: 24a830a0f1256e371d36a1f7f72e5e85a38037d1de2f6f966eb8457db42ff6d6.

primary_sources.title: Local VectorStore Implementation
primary_sources.synthesis: 30-line in-memory vector store stub using Python dict with cosine similarity. Methods: upsert(_id, vector, metadata) and knn(query, k, where). No external database or embedding service. Functional for development/testing.

primary_sources.title: Forensic Audit Report - Vector Store Assessment
primary_sources.synthesis: Confirmed VectorStore is in-memory stub (NOT production AstraDB). Basic cosine similarity implementation. No persistence, no scalability. Suitable for proof-of-concept only.
